verdicts.note: The paper finds that LSFs have only limited influence on fcc–hcp phase stability; hcp stability at low temperature is also predicted by the FS scheme, so attributing it specifically to LSF-induced magnetic effects overstates their causal role.

The constant σ = 5 mJ m⁻² assumption was used to calculate stacking-fault energy, not to calculate the interfacial energy itself, which was obtained using the thermodynamic model and supercell results.
The paper does not propose future work or explicitly call for extending the investigation to other systems.
